description: This file defines a Java interface called DefaultOption, which includes a method to determine if an option is default and a static method to retrieve the default enum constant from an enum class that implements DefaultOption.

classes.name: DefaultOption
classes.description: An interface for options that can be marked as default and include a static method to retrieve the default enum constant.

methods.name: isDefault
methods.description: Method to determine if the current option is marked as default.

methods.name: getDefault
methods.description: Static generic method to retrieve the enum constant marked as default from a class implementing DefaultOption.
